profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Moveworks from ServiceNow
profile.summary:
- Competency with hands-on experience in both Hadoop cluster administration and Big Data application development.
- Managed GPU Kubernetes cluster and provided MLOps support to Data Scientists
- Solid understanding and practical experience with AWS and Hadoop ecosystem (YARN/MapReduce/Hive/Spark/Oozie/Airflow)
- Developed Spark applications to process Kafka stream transaction data to populate sales report
- Adjusted Hadoop cluster configurations to achieve performance improvement and resolved system environment issues.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Data Platform Team, Senior Software Engineer II

- Owned and managed big-data infrastructure, including EMR, Athena (Data Lake), and Snowflake (Data Warehouse).
- Leveraged industry-standard technologies such as Airflow, Hudi, and Terraform to build scalable, maintainable, and production-grade data systems.
- Built and operated an in-house Temporal platform to support mission-critical workflows with high reliability and fault tolerance.
- Led the architecture and operations of the company’s service log pipeline, powering customer-facing analytics and downstream data workflows.
- Designed and developed a scalable event-logging framework that serves as the foundation of the organization’s SIEM logging pipeline.

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Data Infrastructure Team, Senior Backend Engineer

- Processed sales transaction data from Kafka stream to populate sales report in near real-time (NRT) by leveraging Spark with Airflow scheduler
- Managed GPU Kubernetes cluster and provided MLOps support offering Feature Engineering/ML tools to Data Scientists
- Gatekeeper to manage and monitor all the company's EMR (Hadoop) clusters (more than a hundred)
- Provided general guidance to users to troubleshoot and tune Hive/Spark applications
- Designed and developed company's internal API service where users can easily spawn customized EMR clusters

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description:
Big Data Platform Team, Sr. Data Engineer

- Administered 24/7 multi-tenant CDH Hadoop cluster
- Supported stakeholders located globally (Palo Alto, Seattle, Shanghai) who use the Hadoop data and cluster for mission critical applications
- Managed Sqoop ETL applications to collect and refine data from various data sources (OLTP, Data Mart, Weblogs)
- Heavily participated on company-wide cloud migration project, especially focused on Big Data platform part
- Migrated on-premise CDH cluster to EMR clusters
- Automated EMR cluster provisioning process with DevOps tools (Ansible, Bigtop-puppet).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Data Platform Team, Hadoop Engineer

- Developed Storm application to calculate main web page latency statistics in nearly real-time (NRT)
- Collaborated building Weblog data ingestion pipeline which collects user’s behavior data and send to Kafka and HDFS
- Managed Web Coupon generating system (consists of MapReduce, Hbase, and Redis) which expose seller items with competitive price compared to other e-commerce website

---------------------------

Intranet Team, Software Engineer

- Developed in-house code deployment web application integrated with Git version control system
- Developed intranet task management application integrating with other in-house administration tools
